name: Monitoring
when: Watching a metric, alert or scheduled job

variants.name: Beacon
variants.desc: A beacon on its head turns and flashes.

variants.name: Pulse
variants.desc: A heartbeat line runs underneath, eyes following.

variants.name: Camera
variants.desc: A security camera pans in step with its eyes.

variants.name: Gauge
variants.desc: Keeps an eye on a gauge that twitches into amber.

parts.t: <g class="att att-bino"><path class="bino" d="{{a.bnd}}"></path><circle cx="{{a.shx1}}" cy="{{a.shy1}}" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"></circle><circle cx="{{a.shx2}}" cy="{{a.shy2}}" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"></circle></g>

<g class="fx-beacon" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 16)"><g transform="translate(0 -6)"><g class="vb0 bms"><path class="beam2" d="M0 0L32 -9V7Z"></path></g></g><rect class="dk" x="-6.5" y="-2.5" width="13" height="3.5" rx="1.2"></rect><path class="bcn" d="M-4.5 -2.5V-6A4.5 4.5 0 0 1 4.5 -6V-2.5Z"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-ecg" transform="translate(0 {{a.dn}})"><g transform="translate(50 91)"><path class="ecgb" d="M-30 0H-12L-9 -6L-5 7L-2 -10L1 4L3 0H30"></path><path class="ecg" d="M-30 0H-12L-9 -6L-5 7L-2 -10L1 4L3 0H30"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-cam" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(94 8) scale(1.3)"><path class="dk2" d="M3.5 -5V5M3.5 0H0"></path><g class="vb0 cam"><rect class="pw" x="-14" y="-4" width="13" height="8" rx="1.5"></rect><rect class="dk" x="-17" y="-3" width="3.5" height="6" rx="1"></rect><circle class="a led2" cx="-4" cy="-1" r="1.2"></circle></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-gauge" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.mo}})"><g transform="translate(94 60)"><path class="pw" d="M-11.5 1A11.5 11.5 0 0 1 11.5 1Z"></path><path class="ga1" d="M-8 0A8 8 0 0 1 -4 -6.9"></path><path class="ga2" d="M-4 -6.9A8 8 0 0 1 4 -6.9"></path><path class="ga3" d="M4 -6.9A8 8 0 0 1 8 0"></path><g class="vb0 ndl"><path class="dk2" d="M0 0V-7"></path></g><circle class="dk" cx="0" cy="0" r="1.8"></circle></g></g>
